findings.title: source_surface='pos' for kiosk-source order (Order.source=10)
findings.summary: Order #7 has source=10 (KIOSK enum) but source_surface='pos' (capture mechanism). This is by design for V1 LOCAL counter-collect path. The semantic split between source (origin device) and source_surface (capture point) is correct and intentional, but operators reading audit_logs.payload alone may mis-attribute orders to POS when the customer placed them on the kiosk borne and a cashier merely collected cash.
findings.recommendation: No code change. Document in operator runbook that Order.source=10 + source_surface='pos' = kiosk-placed + counter-collected (V1 LOCAL pattern), while Order.source=10 + source_surface='kiosk' = Stripe-TPE direct (V2 cloud or post-TPE hardware integration).

findings.title: Backup soft-warn floor triggers in low-data V1 LOCAL environment
findings.summary: Today's daily-2026-05-28.sql.gz is 75 KB, well below the foodking:backup-daily --warn-bytes default of 1 MB. This will log a soft warning to monitoring. Hard-fail floor (1024 bytes) is cleared with ~75× margin.
findings.recommendation: Defer until real data accumulates. Document that V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne pre-launch backups will soft-warn until ~50 orders/day average is reached. No code change.
